text:
Noah: Nimbus Health called about a +1.8k tokens mismatch on April invoice, says embedding counts seem inflated.
Priya: do we have any unusual backfills or rate-limit changes around Apr 8-9?
Ethan: there's a scheduled dedup migration that ran Apr 08 02:10Z. I see a race where the migration and a retrying backfill both wrote usage rows.
Noah: log excerpt from backfill-runner-2:
```
[2026-04-08T02:11:03Z] INFO backfill batch_id=bf-998 processed=256 embeds=256 tokens=5120 customer=nimbus tier=reserved
[2026-04-08T02:11:03Z] WARN retrying request_id=rq_7f9 attempt=2
[2026-04-08T02:11:04Z] INFO write_usage customer=nimbus request_id=rq_7f9 tokens=20 embeds=1 billed=true
```
Priya: sounds like request_id isn't being enforced as unique until after write. We'll need to dedupe on request_id and source_run_id.
Ethan: SQL to find duplicates:
```
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(tokens) tok
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id='nimbus' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-08' AND '2026-04-09'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING cnt>1;
```
Noah: estimate impact: ~370k extra tokens ~ $1,900.
Priya: propose provisional credit $1,900 pending recompute. Approve?
Ethan: approve.
billing-bot: Invoice job 2026-04-10 completed for customer=nimbus invoice_id=inv_2026_04_NIMBUS
CS-bot: Notified customer with draft message about investigation.
Priya: run recompute in staging with dedup=true, then prod if diff matches. Attach diff CSV and accountants memo (GL codes).
Ethan: staging run done: removed 369,820 tokens, 256 embed units, delta=-$1,894.77. Created adjustment adj_1762_nimbus pending finance signoff.
billing-bot: Adjustment adj_1762_nimbus created amount=-1894.77 status=pending
Noah: added accounting note GL 4102 correction, supporting csv at /gsheets/nimbus/adj_1762.csv
Priya: finance signs off. Applying credit to next invoice and adding alert rule: when per-customer billed_tokens spike >2x hourly median, notify finance-team.
Ethan: fix deployed to backfill-runner: enforce unique request_id write and idempotent retries. Release tag rwd-backfill@2026.04.09
Noah: closing. Follow-up ticket FIN-3314 to add unit tests for backfill idempotency.
Priya: thanks all, marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
